## Outcome

Closes #

Describe behavior changed and why.

## Dependencies

- [ ] Blocking issues are closed.
- [ ] PR targets `dev`, or is an explicit `dev` to `main` release PR.

## Verification

- [ ] Formatting
- [ ] Lint
- [ ] Typecheck
- [ ] Tests
- [ ] Affected builds
- [ ] Migration reset, when database changed

## Safety

- [ ] Fixtures and logs contain no real source content or secrets.
- [ ] RLS/tenant isolation was reviewed when persistence changed.
- [ ] Retry and idempotency behavior was tested when effects changed.
- [ ] AI disclosure remains minimized and recorded when semantic evaluation changed.
- [ ] Irreversible notification behavior remains explicitly authorized.

## Memory

- [ ] Canonical Markdown and ADRs are updated, or change has no durable-memory impact.
